claim_layers.can_prove: Exact bytes/lengths/digests, enums/flags/conditional values, complete consumption, malformed rejection, pure input/output preservation and original check-exception identity.
claim_layers.cannot_prove: Actual owner/source/handle/Origin/diagnostic identity, raw return adoption, live slot sequencing, store issuance, physical output or runtime admission.

claim_layers.can_prove: Only later actual producer source may prove first slots before derived packing, diagnostic borrow/release, same-owner byte issuance/consumption and strict old48 identity parity.
claim_layers.gate: Author all intended-green states before implementation, then bind exact source-issued APIs. No fixture-only factory or decoded flag counts as this proof.

claim_layers.can_prove: Deterministic generated metadata/bytes reach exact profile maxima and section boundaries with complete retention. No real payload, OS dispatch or timing threshold.
claim_layers.cannot_prove: A valid native history, authenticated resource vector, measured RSS, actual300s fit or a completed84 runtime.

entrypoints.decode_ledger: Exact bytes plus required check; immutable data with cache-only to_dict/to_bytes, never a live owner.
entrypoints.encode_ledger: Exact ordinary builtin value containers plus required check; bytes only after complete valid issuance.
entrypoints.project_legacy: Producer adapter requiring the exact same-owner ProducerSnapshot. Dict/DecodedLedger projection must refuse; positive identity parity waits genuine producer.

independence: No actual target encoder/decoder, producer APIs or fixture outputs are read to author the goldens.
At least one discriminating manually pinned byte record per record type catches field swaps/endian/signedness, supplemented by deterministic full-cap metadata.
All code/data/error/callback scopes are labeled; no stub, serialized ready flag or data-only class is promoted to genuine producer evidence.
Keep actual84 roster/consumer/first-entry/physical writer preparation in parallel. Codec green is a component result, not the requested final state.
pending_before_oracle_freeze: Frozen machine schema/fingerprint and complete ordinary value/API model.
Exact scalar/clock/fold/state validity and malformed error/priority rules.
Exact fragment envelope and full-cap used-length/capacity/padding rules.
Source-issued producer lifecycle/legacy adapter interfaces or explicit later gate for their positive controls.
Root review of finite expanded case budget and independent fixture contract before literal generation.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Every API has UNOBSERVED and its exact scalar domain. HANDLE covers NULL, known0, INVALID and nontrivial64-bit values. BOOL32 covers0/positive/negative/signed extrema. DWORD covers0/nontrivial/all-ones; count/error observed versus definedness remain separate.
planned_fixture_families.oracle: Hand-authored field values and fixed expected byte anchors; no source encoder used to create expectations.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: I64 and finiteF64, known0 versus no sample, integer above2^53, negative/signed boundaries and float negative-zero. Known/hash/copy contributions are canonical lower bounds and cannot erase raw knowncount or hide failed fold.
planned_fixture_families.pending: Final schema must close raw type tags, invalid samples, fold/stop legality and exact partial-contribution laws before fixtures freeze.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Every table offset/length/count/version/section ID, overlap/gap/trailing byte, digest, reserved region and enum/flag mask. Check lengths before copy/allocation; no unbounded every-byte scan corpus.
planned_fixture_families.isolation: Semantic mutations recompute dependent hashes where required. Dedicated digest failures do not. Earliest rejection and byte-consumption rules must be declared before code.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Captured software/metadata and hash-only; genuine empty capture versus no blob; capture/hash/open/close states; closed module graph; source/digest/byte evidence are distinct.
planned_fixture_families.gate: Data-only decoded context cannot satisfy ProducerSnapshot or mint ownership. Byte getter/module promotion controls require genuine producer.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Exact1024-byte records, UTF8 lengths/truncation/zero padding, committed identity IDs, formatter fallback, valid secondary/call links and all state enums.
planned_fixture_families.genuine_producer: Borrow/release unfilled reservations across more thanD/2 successful calls while committed entries remain immutable; preserve original identities and bounded post-fault cleanup. Final static slot arrays alone are not lifecycle proof.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Distinct candidate/terminal facts and previous-ledger link, all14 artifact slots and conditional states/caps, missing/partial/unknown artifacts remain explicit.
planned_fixture_families.genuine_producer: Actual same-owner immutable bytes, no candidate alias to later close facts, pre-issuance freeze failures, original exception/first cells preserved and no new work after stop.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Strict structural mapping for supported capture-only facts; reject hash-only/malformed or data-only projected ownership. Retain oldDATA/48/validator unchanged.
planned_fixture_families.genuine_producer: Actual opaque tokens/refs/earlybytes remain identical under external owner checks. Never recreate them from numeric packed IDs.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Generated metadata exercises last legal ordinal and each section high-water boundary under full profile, includingC16384/N256/M128/E2240/D5056 capacities when final schema permits.
planned_fixture_families.oracle: One exact length/section map/digest from an independent deterministic literal recipe, separately source-pinned; label capacity-only fixtures and active versus unused slots. No actual file/model bodies or fabricated successful history.

planned_fixture_families.coverage: Exact builtin type refusals including subclasses/metaclass hooks; mutable-input snapshot behavior; immutable decoded values/cached bytes; required check returns ignored and all raised BaseExceptions retain original identity.
planned_fixture_families.scope: Only pure codec check callbacks here, not runtime file/Sink callbacks. Positive legacy/lifecycle checks remain producer integration.

profile_matrix.fragment: UNQUALIFIED_FRAGMENT/FRAGMENT/INCOMPLETE, N1/Cused1/M0 and reservedR/C/E0, qualification0, exact target/frame domains.
profile_matrix.no_activation: API8..14 cannot enter a complete ledger until a separately frozen physical profile exists.

proposed_budget.meaning: Planning ceiling only, not generation/source authorization. Final schema determines exact expanded IDs/counts; all positive/negative/mutation recipes are counted honestly before freeze. Repeated check fault calls and getters are counted separately from unique vectors.
proposed_budget.memory: Materialize/release one full-cap case at a time; no corpus of duplicated14.8MB buffers and no resource-fit claim.

proposed_corpus_shape.expected: No runtime/physical qualification. Freeze accepted/rejected data outcome, exact semantic facts and original-exception rules before implementation. Invalid data never gains authority from a parsed status.
proposed_corpus_shape.form: Exactly one semantic value plus expected literal bytes, raw literal bytes plus expected decoded value/rejection, or a fully specified generated-metadata byte recipe with exact expected section map/length/hash.
